text: Environmental science and engineering is an interdisciplinary subject centered on addressing environmental issues. It integrates natural sciences (chemistry, biology, geoscience), engineering technologies (environmental engineering, chemical engineering), and social sciences (environmental management, policy and regulations) to study the formation mechanisms, monitoring methods, treatment technologies, and ecological protection strategies of environmental pollution. Its core task is to achieve the full-chain management of "pollution source control - environmental restoration - sustainable development" through theoretical research and engineering practice, covering environmental media such as air, water, soil and solid waste, as well as cutting-edge fields such as ecological planning and low-carbon technologies.
